## Using AI assistants

You may use them AI on assignments however you must:

1. Cite what you used on graded work, the same way you would cite a classmate or a StackOverflow answer.  

2. Do not submit code you cannot explain. The exams are on paper and the questions are about reasoning, so code you did not understand will not help you there. If AI gives you something that works and you are unsure why, that is a good office hours question.
